gen-gf-oxanium-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab stands tall in every lowercase letter, grounded and refined, while Oxanium draws its big-looking lowercase in one unbroken line. Paragraphs would move along steadily.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-erode: Erode reads dignified and editorial, its stroke swelling and easing gently. Oxanium's single-width lines give the headings a sharper edge, and the serif underneath softens that into a comfortable middle path.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-hoover: Hoover is a robust text serif with a generous entry into the e and short, compressed ascenders. And Oxanium does the commanding part, its monoline curves ending in clear daylight, so the body can simply read.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-trench-slab: Trench Slab keeps its lowercase close to the capitals' height, dignified and refined. If the text serif goes large, it would crowd Oxanium's cut-in-one-depth heading, so give the heading more size.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-domine: Domine is a refined text serif with compact ascenders and a breathing space inside every curve. Make Oxanium small and its joins, as thick as its strokes, lose their punch, while a large Domine would crowd it out.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-esteban: Esteban's thin parts are barely slimmer than its stems, and its lowercase looks oversized beside the capitals, with an e that never squeezes shut. Oxanium's bent-paperclip strokes sit above it with quiet confidence.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-faustina: A single line weight gives Oxanium its distinctive, commanding look, with a tall lowercase that seems oversized. And Faustina, a classic serif with a faint thick-thin shift, settles beneath it like an authoritative second voice.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-halant: Halant reads traditional and authoritative, a classic serif whose thins are only slightly lighter than its thicks. And Oxanium, cut at one fixed nib width, gives the headings a firmer, more modern edge above it.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-headland-one: Headland One spaces its letters well apart, with a tall rounded o nearly matching the capital, so nothing ever touches. Oxanium's slim joins make a crisp contrast.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Hedvig Letters Serif is a text serif with open-ended curves, a sturdy tall body and medium-low contrast, while Oxanium holds one constant line width. Long paragraphs would feel steady.
